mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The current rate of 0.36% is below the historical average, supporting this prediction.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the months when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation, as measured by CPIAUCSL exceeding 240.0, signals an environment where the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 240.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising industrial production (INDPRO) and falling housing starts (HOUST) signals a weakening economy where the demand for housing is contracting while supply is expanding, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO > 103.0 and HOUST < 1180.0.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, characterized by strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 16500.0) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to impending monetary tightening and economic peak.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when GDPC1 > 16500.0 and UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5%, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened economic uncertainty and potential policy responses.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the months when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising residential sales (RSAFS) and low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) signals a supportive housing market and accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS > 446000.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.4%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher residential sales figure (RSAFS) indicates strong housing market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the months when RSAFS is above the historical average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 1.0%, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to the expectation of a tighter monetary policy environment.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the months when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0%.
